ability.name: Kunai Strike
ability.description:
Adaptor %i:scaleAD%: Throw a volley of kunai at the target, dealing @PhysicalDamageBase@% (%i:scaleAD%) + @PhysicalDamageAP@ (%i:scaleAP%) physical damage. If the target is Burning, deal an additional @BonusPhysicalDamage@% (%i:scaleAD%) damage.
Adaptor %i:scaleAP%: If the Ability kills, cast it again.

ability.name: Defensive Sweep
ability.description: Slice the target for @AbilityDamage@% (%i:scaleAD%) + @APDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) physical damage and gain @AbilityShield@ Shield for 2 seconds.

ability.name: Razor Leaves
ability.description:
Summon five razor-sharp leaves that converge on the current target, dealing a total of @SpellDamageAD@% (%i:scaleAD%) + @SpellDamageAP@ (%i:scaleAP%) physical damage and applying 20% Wound and 1% Burn for 4 seconds.
Scarlet Buff: Cinderling gains 22% Attack Damage each cast.
Wound: Reduces healing received.
Burn: Deals a percent of the target’s max Health as true damage every second.

ability.name: Karmic Bond
ability.description:
Tether the current target, dealing @DamageTetherAP@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage over 1.5 seconds. Then release a burst of power around them, dealing @DamageAoEAP@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to all enemies in a 1 Hex radius and 30% Slowing them for 2 seconds.
Slow: Reduce Attack Speed

ability.name: Dance of Life
ability.description: Restore @FlatHealAmount@ (%i:scaleAP%) + 7% (%i:scaleHealth%) max Health Health over 2 seconds. The next attack is replaced with a bash that deals 10% (%i:scaleHealth%) max Health + @FlatDamageAmount@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.

ability.name: Shield Bash
ability.description:
Passive: Start combat with @DecayingArmorAndMagicResist@ (%i:scaleAP%) bonus Armor and Magic Resist that decays over 12 seconds.
Active: Bash the current target, dealing @PercentArmorDamage@% (%i:scaleArmor%) magic damage and Stunning them for 1.5 seconds.

ability.name: Bellows Breath
ability.description:
Active: Gain @ShieldAmount@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for 4 seconds and deal @MagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies in a cone.
Quest: Each player combat, Ornn stores damage blocked as Forge Power, doubled at 3-star. Gain an Artifact Anvil each time he gains enough Forge Power.

ability.name: Azure Laser
ability.description:
Begin consuming 35% max Mana per second and channeling a laser on the target. Each second while casting, deal @SpellDamagePerSecond@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to them and reduce their Magic Resist by 3.
Teal Buff: Gain 2 Mana Regen for every 4 seconds channeled.

ability.name: Entrancing Dance
ability.description: Gain @ShieldAmount@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for 4 seconds. Then grant the ally who has dealt the most damage this combat @DecayingAttackSpeed@ (%i:scaleAP%) + 1 (%i:scaleAP%) decaying Attack Speed for 4 seconds.

ability.name: Uproot
ability.description:
Passive: Restore @HealthRegenFlat@ Health each second, tripled for 3 seconds after casting.
Active: Lunge out of the ground, Stunning adjacent enemies for 1 second and dealing @SpellDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to them.

ability.name: Piercing Arrow
ability.description: Wind up, then fire an arrow at the most enemies in line with the target. It deals @ADDamage@% (%i:scaleAD%) + @APDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) physical damage to enemies hit, reduced by 40% for each enemy it passes through (minimum 40%).

ability.name: Primordial Burst
ability.description:
Launch a giant blast at the target that deals @HighHPSpellDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage, increased to @LowHPSpellDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) if they're below 30% max Health.
If they die, permanently gain 1.5% Ability Power.

ability.name: Deadly Plumage
ability.description: Gain 50% Attack Speed for the next 5 attacks. These attacks are replaced with feathers that deal @FeatherADRatio@% (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage and reduce Armor by 2 (%i:scaleAP%).

ability.name: Last Rites
ability.description:
Passive: On death, spawn a Spirit Walker with @GhoulHealthBase@ + 20% (%i:scaleHealth%) max Health max Health which immediately taunts, forcing enemies to attack it.
Active: Restore @StrikeHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%) Health and strike the target, dealing @StrikeDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) physical damage.

ability.name: Triumphant Roar
ability.description: Roar, restoring 8% (%i:scaleHealth%) max Health Health, cleansing disables, and healing the two lowest percent Health allies for @AllyHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%). Then slam the current target, dealing @Damage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage and Stunning them for 1.5 seconds.

ability.name: Headshot
ability.description: Passive: Every third attack is replaced with a Headshot that deals @SpellDamageAD@% (%i:scaleAD%) + @SpellDamageAP@ (%i:scaleAP%) physical damage.

ability.name: Spider Queen
ability.description: Transform into a spider and gain @SpiderHealthBuff@ max Health. Attacks while in Spider Form deal @DamageOnAttack@ (%i:scaleAP%) bonus magic damage and heal for @HealOnAttack@ (%i:scaleAP%). Subsequent casts grant 175% decaying Attack Speed for 4 seconds.

ability.name: Belchy Bubble
ability.description:
Adaptor %i:scaleAP%: Belch a noxious bubble at the current target that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing @MainTargetDamageAP@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. Enemies within a 1 hex radius of the explosion take @SecondaryDamageAP@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage over 3 seconds.
Adaptor %i:scaleAD%: Heavily slows the target.
Purple Buff: Every 5 seconds, Gromp gains 30% Ability Power.

ability.name: Solar Judgement
ability.description:
Passive: Kayle ascends based on her star level, granting her stacking bonuses.
1st Ascension: Attacks deal @MagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) bonus magic damage.
2nd Ascension: Attacks 20% Shred enemies hit for 2 seconds.
3rd Ascension: Attacks fire waves, dealing 40 (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to all other units hit.
4th Ascension: Gain infinite range. Every 3rd wave is much larger.
Shred: Reduce Magic Resist

ability.name: Mirror Image
ability.description:
Passive: After player combat, your strongest LeBlanc has a @PercentChanceToPrint@% chance to create a copy of an ally on your board, increased by 4% per takedown.
Active: Launch a mirror image at the current target, dealing @SingleTargetDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage and @AOEDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) to adjacent enemies.

ability.name: Rending Claws
ability.description:
Leap to the lowest Health enemy within 3 Hexes and deal @LeapDamageAD@% (%i:scaleAD%) + @LeapDamageAP@ (%i:scaleAP%) physical damage. The next 2 attacks gain 175% Attack Speed and deal @EmpoweredDamageAD@% (%i:scaleAD%) bonus physical damage.
Grey Buff: Gain Precision and 25% Critical Strike Chance, increased up to 75% based on missing Health.

ability.name: Can You Dig It?
ability.description:
Passive: Attacks are replaced by a dance that deals @AutoAttackDamage@% (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to all adjacent enemies.
Active: Burrow underground, gaining 15% Durability for 3 seconds and healing @BurrowTotalHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%) over the duration.
Green Buff: When allies fall below 50% Health, they restore 15% max Health.

ability.name: Sun's Wrath
ability.description: Gain @ShieldAP@ (%i:scaleAP%) + 10% (%i:scaleHealth%) max Health Shield for 4 seconds. Then cleave in a cone, dealing @ConeDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage and strike in a line, dealing @SlamDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies hit.

ability.name: Ki Barrier
ability.description: Grant @MagicShieldAmount@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield to Shen and @AllyShieldAmount@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield to a nearby damaged ally for 4 seconds. Both of their next 3 attacks gain 40% Attack Speed and deal @AttackMagicDamageBuff@ (%i:scaleAP%) bonus magic damage.

ability.name: Fungus Among Us
ability.description:
Throw 2 clusters of mushrooms that deal @APDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to the 3 nearest enemies. Then hurl a giant mushroom that deals @BigMushroomDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to the target.
Each cast has a @PercentChanceOfForage@% chance to forage an extra mushroom that can be collected for bonus effects.
Red: 1 Reroll
Green: 1 Tactician Health
Yellow: 2 XP

ability.name: Jaws of The Beast
ability.description: Bite the current target, dealing @BiteDamage@% (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage and healing for 20% (%i:scaleAP%) of the damage dealt. Gain 20% Attack Speed for the rest of combat.

ability.name: Cultivation of Spirit
ability.description: Dash, then launch an orb at the current target that deals @PrimaryDamage@% (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage and splits, dealing 35% physical damage to 2 nearby enemies.

ability.name: Arise!
ability.description: Gain 150% Attack Speed and summon 2 soldiers for the next 6 attacks. These attacks are replaced by commands which direct each soldier to deal @SoldierDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage per attack.

ability.name: Noxious Blast
ability.description: Poison the target and the nearest non-poisoned enemy, dealing @Damage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage over 15 seconds. Poisons stack.

ability.name: Pale Barrier
ability.description: Gain @ShieldAmount@ shield for 2 seconds and send out 6 moonlight orbs spread among enemies within 2 hexes, each dealing @OrbDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.

ability.name: Harvest
ability.description: Reduce the Magic Resist of the 3 nearest enemies by 10. Then drain life from them over 2 seconds, healing for @Healing@ (%i:scaleAP%) Health and dealing @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to each over the duration.

ability.name: Spirit of Dread
ability.description: Gain 50 Armor and Magic Resist for 3 seconds and restore @Heal@ (%i:scaleAP%) Health over the duration. Launch spectral riders at the 3 nearest enemies, dealing @SpellDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage and Stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Taste Their Fear
ability.description: Leap to the farthest enemy within 2.7 Hexes, dealing @BaseDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. If they have no adjacent allies, deal @IsolateDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage instead and gain 10 mana.

ability.name: Raining Artillery
ability.description:
Adaptor %i:scaleAD%: Launch acid at the target and the other nearest enemy, dealing @ADSpellDamageBase@% (%i:scaleAD%) + @ADSpellDamageAP@ (%i:scaleAP%) physical damage. Enemies below 50% max Health take 1.4 physical damage instead.
Adaptor%i:scaleAP%: Damages enemies over time.

ability.name: Rock and Roll
ability.description:
Passive: On death, split into two Kruglettes with @HPBaseMini@ + 12% (%i:scaleHealth%) max Health Health which immediately taunt, forcing enemies to attack them.
Active: Gain @SpellHealthIncrease@ (%i:scaleAP%) max Health, then roll into the target, dealing @ADDamage@% (%i:scaleAD%) + 8% (%i:scaleHealth%) max Health damage.
Slate Buff: On death, Krug and Kruglettes Shield allies for 8% max Health.

ability.name: Flock Family
ability.description:
Summon 4 untargetable Tiny Beaks nearby for 5 (%i:scaleAP%) seconds. Whenever Mama Beak attacks, Tiny Beaks attack the same enemy, dealing @MiniDamagePerAttack@% (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage.
Orange Buff: Dealing physical damage reduces enemy Armor by 2.

ability.name: Wuju Style
ability.description:
Passive: Every third attack is a Double Strike. On takedown, gain a burst of movement speed.
Adaptor %i:scaleAD%: Double Strikes grant 12% + 3% (%i:scaleAP%) stacking Attack Speed.
Adaptor %i:scaleAP%: Double Strikes deal bonus damage and heal.

ability.name: Defensive Ball Curl
ability.description:
Taunt, forcing enemies to attack this champion. For 4 seconds, gain @Shield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield and 60 Armor and Magic Resist.
When the Shield breaks, deal @ArmorMRDamageRatioBase@% (%i:scaleArmor%) + @ArmorMRDamageRatio2@% (%i:scaleMR%) physical damage to enemies in 2 Hexes.

ability.name: Savagery
ability.description: Jump to the lowest percent Health enemy within 3 hexes and stab them, dealing @StabDamage@% (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage. Then heal for @HealMin@ (%i:scaleAP%), increased to up to @HealMax@ (%i:scaleAP%) based on their missing Health.

ability.name: Explosive Charge
ability.description:
Attach an explosive charge to the target that lasts 4 seconds. While active, gain infinite range and 40% + 20% (%i:scaleAP%) Attack Speed. After the duration, the charge explodes and splits damage between all enemies within 2 hexes, dealing @AOEDamageBase@% (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage + @AOEDamagePerStack@% (%i:scaleAD%) for each attack while casting.
If an enemy with an explosive charge on them dies, it attaches to Tristana's new target.

ability.name: Furious Fists
ability.description:
Passive: On attack, restore 2% (%i:scaleHealth%) max Health Health.
Active: Unleash a primal roar, restoring @SpellInstantHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%) Health. Then gain @SpellAS@% Attack Speed, 15% Durability, and is Unstoppable for 3 seconds.

ability.name: Spirit Bomb
ability.description: Launch a spirit bomb at the location within 4 hexes that has the most surrounding enemies. It deals @OrbDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies in a 3 hex radius, reduced by 20% per hex away from the epicenter.

ability.name: Tantrum
ability.description:
Passive: Every second, restore @PassiveHealPercent@% (%i:scaleHealth%) max Health Health and deal @PassiveDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies within 1 hex.
Active: Deal @DamageBig@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies within 2 hexes and Stun them for @StunDurationBase@ seconds, increased to @StunDuration2@ seconds if the target is Burning.
Burn: Deals a percent of the target’s max Health as true damage every second.

ability.name: Moonlight's Onslaught
ability.description:
Equip Severum and swipe the target 5 times over 2 seconds, each dealing @SwipeDamage@% (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage.
After the onslaught finishes, fire a blast that deals @LunarBlastADDamage@% (%i:scaleAD%) + @LunarBlastAPDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) physical damage split among all enemies in a 2 Hex radius.

ability.name: Crimson Fury
ability.description:
Passive: When the target dies, leap at the next target, dealing @TargetChangeDamage@% (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage.
Active: Gain @FrenzyADPercent@% Attack Damage for 8 seconds. During this time ignore 10% Armor.
Red Buff: Attacks 1% Burn enemies and heal Brambleback for 4% max Health.

ability.name: Forest's Flurry
ability.description:
Blink away from the current target, deal @NormalCastADDamage@% (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to them, and gain @APAttackSpeed@% (%i:scaleAP%) Attack Speed.
Every 4th cast consumes the Attack Speed granted from Nature's Wrath and fires a blast through the largest group of enemies that deals @BigCastADDamage@% (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage, reduced by 25% for each enemy it passes through (minimum 50%).

ability.name: Lilting Lullaby
ability.description: Restore @HealAmount@ (%i:scaleAP%) Health and send 4 butterflies at nearby enemies. Enemies hit take @EnemyInitialDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage and Sleep for @SleepDuration@ seconds. If they take 1000 damage, they wake up and take an additional 10% max Health magic damage.

ability.name: Petrified Bark
ability.description: Gain @ShieldAP@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for 4 seconds and become petrified. When the shield breaks, unleash a wave of dark energy, dealing @SpellDamageRatioArmorMRBase@% (%i:scaleMR%) + @SpellDamageRatioArmorMR2@% (%i:scaleArmor%) + @SpellDamageAP@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies within @AoEHexRange@ hexes.

ability.name: Withering Curse
ability.description:
Passive: Gain 25% Omnivamp.
Active: Fire a dark blast at 3 nearby enemies, dealing @InitialDamageAP@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to them and cursing them for 4 seconds. Then, spawn a 2 Hex withering zone for the same duration that deals @ZoneDPS@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage per second. Cursed enemies take @AdditionalDamagePerCurse@ (%i:scaleAP%) more damage per curse.

ability.name: Javelin Toss
ability.description:
Adaptor %i:scaleAP%: Gain 150% Attack Speed for the next 3 attacks. These attacks are replaced with javelins that deal @EmpoweredDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. The 3rd attack instead targets the furthest enemy with the least items and deals @ThirdAttackEmpoweredDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.
Adaptor %i:scaleAD%: Transform into a Melee cougar Assassin that swipes enemies.

ability.name: Azure Shockwave
ability.description:
Gain @ShieldAmount@ (%i:scaleAP%) + 10% (%i:scaleHealth%) max Health Shield for 4 seconds. Slam the ground, sending a fissure in the direction of the most enemies. Enemies hit are briefly knocked up, take @SlamDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage, and are Mana Reaved for 10.
Blue Buff: Each time Sentinel casts, allies gain 2 Mana Regen.
Mana Reave: Increase the Mana cost of the next Ability cast.

ability.name: Haymaker
ability.description:
Passive: Upon falling below 40% max Health the first time each combat, gain 100 mana.
Active: Wind up a big punch, rapidly healing for 12% (%i:scaleHealth%) + @BaseHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%) before dealing @ConeDamage@% (%i:scaleAD%) + 6% (%i:scaleHealth%) max Health physical damage in a large cone.

ability.name: Boomerang Blade
ability.description: Throw a large crossblade that deals @InitialDamageAD@% (%i:scaleAD%) + @InitialDamageAP@ (%i:scaleAP%) physical damage to the current target and bounces 8 times between nearby enemies, dealing @BouncePercent@% physical damage each bounce. When this kills an enemy, bounce @BonusKillBounces@ additional times.

ability.name: Starcall
ability.description: Call down a star on the current target, dealing @DamageAP@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. If a star has previously fallen on them, call down 3 additional stars that each deal @AdditionalStarDamageAP@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.

ability.name: Rampant Growth
ability.description: Spawn @NumPlantsToSpawn@ plants around the battlefield that attack the nearest enemy 10 times. Each attack deals @ThornSpitterDamagePerAttack@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.

ability.name: Moonfall
ability.description:
Rain 9 moonshards split among the 3 nearest enemies, dealing @MoonshardDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage each.
If the moon is full, instead crash it onto the board, dealing @MoonDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage split among all enemies.

ability.name: Spirit Rift
ability.description:
Fire an arrow through the most enemies in a line that deals @ArrowDamage@% (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage, reduced by @DamageFalloffPerEnemy@% per enemy hit (minimum 20%).
The arrow leaves a trail for @RiftDuration@ seconds that deals @RiftDamagePerSecond@% (%i:scaleAD%) + @MaxHealthDamagePerSecond@% max Health physical damage per second to enemies within and 20% Slows them.
Slow: Reduce Attack Speed

ability.name: Whirling Death
ability.description:
Passive: Attacks target random enemies in range and apply a bleed that deals @BleedDamage@% (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage over 12 seconds. Every attack has a 12% (%i:scaleAP%) chance to deal @SpinningAxeDamageRatio@% bonus physical damage and apply 2 bleeds instead.
Active: Throw two giant axes towards the enemy with the most bleeds. Deal @GiantAxeDamage@% (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to enemies hit and consume their bleed, instantly dealing the remaining damage. The axes then return, dealing @GiantAxeReturnDamage@% (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to enemies hit.

ability.name: Heat Without Equal
ability.description:
Passive: Attacks deal @AttackAoERatio@% damage to enemies adjacent to the target.
Active: Become invulnerable and fly into the air. On return, stun all enemies for @StunDuration@ seconds, gain @Omnivamp@% Omnivamp, and Ignite them for @IgniteDurationBase@ seconds. Ignited enemies take @IgniteMaxHealthDamage@% max Health physical damage per second. Replace this ability with Flame Breath and immediately cast it.
Flame Breath: Spew fire at the most enemies in a line through the target, dealing @FireballDamageBase@% (%i:scaleAD%) + @FireballDamageAP@ (%i:scaleAP%) physical damage, reduced by 20% for each enemy it passes through (minimum 20%.) Ignite those enemies for @IgniteDuration2@ seconds.
Elder Dragon Buff: Damaging an enemy below 12% Health executes them.

ability.name: Rage Gene
ability.description:
Passive: Gain @RagePerSecond@ Rage per second and 5 Rage per attack.
Active: Transform into Mega Gnar and leap into the largest group of enemies within 3 hexes. Then, deal @TransformDamage@% (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to enemies within @TransformHexRadius@ hexes, reduce their Armor and Magic Resist by @ArmorMRReduction@ (%i:scaleAP%), and Stun them for @StunDuration@ second. Mega Gnar gains @TransformHealth@ Health, and replaces his Ability with Grab n' Throw.
Grab n' Throw: Throw the target at the farthest enemy, dealing @PrimaryTargetDamage@% (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to them and @SecondaryTargetDamage@% (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to enemies they pass through. If there's only 1 enemy left, throw them off the battlefield instead.

ability.name: Triggerseed
ability.description:
Passive: Shields from this Ability can critically strike with Precision.
Active: Grant @NumAlliesToShield@ allies @ShieldAmount@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield and @DamageAmpAmount@% Damage Amp for 6 seconds. Then deal @MagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies adjacent to them. After casting 6 times, also grant 100% stacking Attack Speed to targets.

ability.name: Firestorm
ability.description:
Charge up, gaining 15% Ability Power per Burning enemy. Then, gain @ShieldAP@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for 2.5 seconds and rush through a nearby group of enemies, dealing @DashDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to each.
After rushing, unleash a 2 Hex firestorm that deals a total of @FirestormDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage split among all enemies hit over 2 seconds.

ability.name: Final Spark
ability.description:
Passive: On cast, all allies that share a trait with Lux gain @ManaForAllies@ (%i:scaleAP%) mana.
Active: Fire a laser towards the largest group of enemies that deals @LaserDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage, reduced by @DamageReductionPerUnit@% for each enemy hit.

ability.name: Sow the Seeds
ability.description:
Passive: After every @DamageMitigatedPerSapling@ damage blocked, a sapling jumps towards a nearby enemy and deals @SaplingDamageHealthScalar@% (%i:scaleHealth%) max Health magic damage. On death, @SaplingsOnDeath@ saplings jump out.
Active: Deal @ActiveDamageHealthScalar@% (%i:scaleHealth%) max Health magic damage to target and restore @ActiveBaseHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%) + @ActiveMissingHealthHeal@% missing Health.

ability.name: Emerald Radiance
ability.description:
Passive: The first time Taric or his paired ally drops below 50% Health, unleash emerald energy from both of them, granting @PassiveShieldBase@ + @PassiveShieldHealthScalar@% (%i:scaleHealth%) max Health Shield to allies within 3 Hexes for @PassiveShieldDuration@ seconds.
Active: Restore @HealAmount@ (%i:scaleAP%) Health. Taric and his paired ally deal @ShatterBonusDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) bonus magic damage on their next 2 attacks.

traits.name: Thích Ứng
traits.description:
Thiên Phú: Kỹ năng của tướng Thích Ứng sẽ thay đổi tùy theo việc Sức Mạnh Công Kích hay Sức Mạnh Phép Thuật của họ cao hơn.
Tướng Thích Ứng nhận thêm Sức Mạnh Phép Thuật hoặc Sức Mạnh Công Kích, tùy vào chỉ số nào cao hơn.
(@MinUnits@) @ADAPGain*100@% HOẶC
(@MinUnits@) @ADAPGain*100@% HOẶC
(@MinUnits@) @ADAPGain*100@% HOẶC

traits.name: Bá Chủ
traits.description: Rồng Ngàn Tuổi chiếm 2 vị trí đội hình và tăng thêm 2 mốc vào tộc/hệ Quái Rừng.

traits.name: Hòa Hợp
traits.description: Alune mạnh nhất của bạn sẽ chuyển sang một pha trăng mới sau mỗi lần thi triển. Khi mặt trăng ở pha bán nguyệt hoặc khuyết hơn, đội của bạn nhận @Durability*100@% Chống Chịu. Khi ở những pha còn lại, đội của bạn nhận @DamageAmp*100@% Khuếch Đại Sát Thương.

traits.name: Thế Thần
traits.description:
Sở hữu một tướng Thế Thần sẽ biến mọi tướng Thế Thần khác trong cửa hàng của bạn về Tộc/Hệ của tướng Thế Thần đó.
Tộc/Hệ được chọn của tướng Thế Thần sẽ được tính gấp đôi cho các mốc thưởng Tộc/Hệ.

traits.name: Gai Đen
traits.description:
Đồng minh trên ô Gai Đen sẽ bị hiến tế trước khi giao tranh, tăng Máu cho các tướng của bạn.
Tướng Gai Đen nhận thêm chỉ số dựa trên Vai Trò, Cấp Sao và Giá của vật tế.
(@MinUnits@) @Health@ %i:scaleHealth%
(@MinUnits@) @Health@ %i:scaleHealth%; Hiệu ứng cộng thêm mạnh hơn @StatMultiplier*100@%
(@MinUnits@) @Health@ %i:scaleHealth%; Hiệu ứng cộng thêm mạnh hơn @StatMultiplier*100@%

traits.name: Hoa Linh
traits.description:
Sau giao tranh, các Tinh Linh của bạn được cường hóa.
Tướng Hoa Linh nhận thêm Sức Mạnh Công Kích, Sức Mạnh Phép Thuật và @BonusHealth*100@% Máu tối đa.
(@MinUnits@) Tinh Linh được nâng cấp, @ADAP*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%
(@MinUnits@) Tinh Linh xuất hiện trong mọi cửa hàng, @ADAP*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%
(@MinUnits@) Nhận @GoldPerCharmPurchased@ vàng sau khi mua 1 Tinh Linh, @ADAP*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%
(@MinUnits@) Bạn có thể mua 2 Tinh Linh mỗi vòng, @ADAP*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%
(@MinUnits@) Tinh Linh tràn đầy sức mạnh, @ADAP*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%

traits.name: Săn Thưởng
traits.description: Chọn một nhiệm vụ. Draven mạnh nhất của bạn có thể hoàn thành nhiệm vụ săn thưởng để nhận phần thưởng tương ứng. Sau khi hoàn thành một nhiệm vụ săn thưởng, hãy chọn nhiệm vụ tiếp theo.

traits.name: Đấu Sĩ
traits.description:
Đội của bạn nhận thêm @BrawlerTeamHealth@ Máu tối đa. Tướng Đấu Sĩ nhận được nhiều hơn.
(@MinUnits@) @BrawlerHealthPercent*100@% %i:scaleHealth%
(@MinUnits@) @BrawlerHealthPercent*100@% %i:scaleHealth%
(@MinUnits@) @BrawlerHealthPercent*100@% %i:scaleHealth%

traits.name: Ăn Mòn
